body: Pick the campus buildings you would travel to, add the housing addresses you are considering, and see which ones a Madison Metro bus connects — directly, with one transfer, or not suitably. Walking distances only: this page shows no times, schedules or predictions, because a bus that exists on the map is not a promise about when it runs.
blocks.lead: From a housing address to campus, by bus.
blocks.title: Bus Routes from Home

blocks.credit: Bus routes: Data provided under license granted by City of Madison, WI, Metro Transit. Addresses and building places: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Route data read 11 November 2026 (feed S072_202608240858, 16 August to 5 December 2026); a stop counts as serving a place when it is within about 500 metres of it, measured in a straight line.
blocks.lead: Several addresses, several buildings, side by side.
blocks.privacy: Your addresses are looked up with OpenStreetMap to place them on the map. They are not kept — not by this site, and not in its records — and only their positions are used for the comparison.
blocks.title: Compare addresses

body: A direct bus on this page means one Metro route stops within the walking distance of both the address and the building. One transfer means two routes meet at a shared stop. No suitable connection means no route comes within the walking distance of both — a longer walk to a stop may still work, and Madison Metro's own trip planner is the place to check a specific journey.
